projects.name: Corsicana Facility
projects.quote: The Corsicana Facility will have a total capacity of 1 GW when fully developed, at which point it is expected to be the largest known Bitcoin mining facility in the world by developed capacity.

projects.name: Corsicana Facility initial 400 MW phase
projects.quote: The remaining two buildings representing the completion of the first 400 MW at our Corsicana Facility are expected to be fully operational by the end of 2024.

projects.name: Rockdale Facility
projects.quote: We also expanded operations at our Rockdale Facility into newly available capacity as we continued to deploy new hash rate at both facilities.

projects.name: Block Mining acquisition
projects.quote: The acquisition includes 60 MW of existing operational capacity with potential to expand to over 300 MW in total in Kentucky.

projects.name: Commerce Drive

projects.name: Blue Steel
projects.quote: 25 MW data center in Calvert City, KY with expansion potential to 55 MW
